description: This file is a Flutter app's main entry point defining the app widget, setting up theming, and displaying a simple home page with a progress indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the root of the application with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the main screen with a customizable title.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage that builds the scaffold containing app bar and centered progress indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the Flutter app, calls runApp with an instance of MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in both MyApp and _MyHomePageState that constructs the widget tree.
